main_text.l: Epistolae Petri prioris enarratio. Epistolae Pauli prioris ad Corinthios cap.7. explicatum. De Iesu Christo vero Iudaeo, & semine Abrahae libellus. page.notes: Line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 stand in the gutter between the two printed pages; they are placed here as notes of the right page's text, not as text. Only "486" is printed as a page number; the right page has no number visible. The left page ends mid-word at "cōm-" and continues at the start of the right page. Several titles are dense and abbreviated, and some words are uncertain (e.g. "Reiffenbuch", "Liechtenbergk", "schotia", "Monachoitului"); they are copied as they appear on the scan, and no [?] marks were added because the print is legible enough to read at this resolution. The final line on the right page is cut off at the foot ("Euang.").
